findings.finding: Exact export codec/file writer and diagnostic module Git blobs are unchanged from v5.0.7 through public v5.0.13 and prepared PR1914. Reuse the source identities; never relabel old native receipts.

Library renderer, translation, layout and model blobs differ between public 5.0.7 and 5.0.13. All six examined paths are byte-identical between public 5.0.13 and prepared PR1914 head; do not generalize to an eventual release freeze.

Current Library dispatch checks owned Settings/Help ancestry before explicit export, passes player_index, and shows the returned profile in a bounded text-box; diagnostic report has separate explicit preview and output paths.

The accepted 5.0.7 two-client native input/lifecycle report expressly excludes settings/import/export-file interaction and separately cold-loading the final save. Prepared 0.4.0 support-export observer assets are not native qualification.
No current 5.0.13/5.0.14 export-file, two-client post-save, native input, or entire-product performance acceptance is established here.
